questions.prompt: What is one trip of the Earth round the Sun called?

options: The tilt of the Earth’s axis
The Earth moving much closer to the Sun
questions.explain: The tilt changes how directly sunlight falls.

questions.prompt: How many days does February have in a leap year?
questions.explain: An extra day every four years.

questions.prompt: In June, India has summer. What season is it in Australia (southern half)?
questions.explain: The southern half leans away from the Sun.
The Sun is up for longer.

questions.prompt: Which season brings most of India’s rain?
questions.explain: Moist winds from the sea bring rain from June to September.

questions.prompt: Why do we need leap years?
options: A year is about 365¼ days, so the quarters add up

questions.prompt: Explain the difference between the Earth’s rotation and revolution.
questions.modelAnswer: Rotation is the Earth spinning on its axis, once every 24 hours, which gives day and night. Revolution is the Earth travelling round the Sun, once in about 365 days, which gives a year and, with the tilt, the seasons.
rubric: Revolution: round the Sun, a year
